channel.desc: Ozzy and Jack pack up a camper and travel to Roswell, N.M.; while Jack is a true UFO believer, Ozzy is a skeptic; in New Mexico, they visit the Petroglyphs National Monument, the UFO Museum and the famous Roswell crash site.[(96057)]
